title: 装箱：四物体匹配槽位—识别正面—持物定向—放入箱底
phases: Identify exactly four target objects and intended box positions. Identify each front/back semantically; do not infer front from a symmetric silhouette axis.
Pick one object using local current silhouette/explicit multiview geometry.

On fresh held-object RGB, place(mode=inside, front_left=true) with current front/back material features and destination support at the actual visible box bottom. Choose normalized slot within locally measured box axes; no copied world coordinates.
Inspect object containment, front direction, and whether box tipped or shifted. Remeasure a moved box instead of using its old rim as the support.
Repeat for four distinct targets, withdraw and home.
failure_lesson: Reference releases left objects outside or with unverified facing; centering over the rim is not placing on the box bottom. Opposite arm/posture sometimes recovered motion.
reference_success_scope: External ordinary/random aggregates include successes, but shared recipes alone are not executable controllers.
